Concurrent persistent chained map generator with transactions, iteration, and verification.

# Purpose
`fd_map_chain_para.c` is a template file that generates a chained hash map API and implementation for a chosen element type and key type. It is designed for use as a header-only component or as a library source file, depending on `MAP_IMPL_STYLE`. The map stores elements in an external element store and links them through per-chain `next` indices. It supports creation, join and leave of local handles, deletion, insertion, removal, lookup, modification, iteration, reset, verification, and error string conversion. The file also supports optional key memoization, custom key comparison and hash functions, and index compression.

The main purpose of the file is to provide concurrent map operations with chain-level versioning and locking. Read-only queries can run speculatively without locking, while insert, remove, modify, and transaction operations use chain locks and version checks to detect conflicts. The file also defines transaction support across multiple keys and chain iteration locks for snapshot-style processing. This makes the map suitable for shared memory, interprocess use, and persistent data layouts where concurrent access and bounded per-chain contention are required.
